_comment: Example Agent Nexus Gateway config. Copy to agent-nexus.config.json (same dir) to use. All keys optional — anything omitted falls back to safe defaults. Secrets should come from env vars, not this file.

server._host_note: Keep '127.0.0.1' for a single local machine. Set '0.0.0.0' (or your LAN IP) ONLY on a trusted private network, behind the API-key/RBAC layer, to let other machines route through this gateway.

security._vault_note: When set, credentials persist encrypted across restarts. The master key is auto-generated and stored beside the vault on first boot unless AGENT_NEXUS_VAULT_KEY is set. Omit vaultPath for an ephemeral in-memory vault (keys lost on restart).

endpoints._comment: Self-hosted local model (Ollama). No apiKey needed. Same shape works for vLLM (:8000/v1) and LM Studio (:1234/v1).
